label: D2 after choosing a1 and landing in S1, in the last ~10 trials of the episode (low value)
explanation: Fires only at D2 and only when the last-action input is a1 (3294/3295 active steps), and only in episode trials 90-99 (essentially none before trial 85), where the model value is low (all activations in the lowest value bin, below 5.2). 96% of mass is on in_state==S1 (common a1 transitions); rare a1->S2 gives weak activations. The feature works as an end-of-episode timer gated by a1->S1. Magnitude rises over consecutive a1->S1 trials as the episode nears its end (e.g. 0.4->0.6->0.8->0.9 across a window) and drops after unrewarded or rare trials. It never fires at D1 or GO, after a2, or before trial ~85. Using value<4 as the observed stand-in for being close to the end of the episode gives dev F1 0.72 and mass recall 0.93. ep_trial>=96 gives a lower F1 of about 0.62. The remaining false positives are late a1->S1 D2 steps with value just under the cutoff, where the feature has not ramped up yet. No future variables are used.
